scope: Strict normalization of two fixed contracts; all inputs doubled, no HTTP32

results.case: Context retains server civil day and explicit profile capabilities without selecting one
No eligible profiles is an explicit empty set, never an adopted professional profile
Missing, extra and reciprocal-authority fields are rejected
Profile IDs, duplicates and eligibility flags require the fixed types
An exhausted page has null cursor; an empty page cannot invent a continuation
Observed count normalization preserves sparse days and actual denominators
No registered snapshots has a null ratio and a distinct status
Unrequested health fields, invalid basis or fabricated ratios fail the whole projection
Query projection dates cannot be future, duplicate, unordered or outside server range
Corrupt count types, overflow and completed greater than registered are unavailable
Response size is a technical validation bound, not an artificial zero-data fallback
Changing the input DTO afterwards cannot mutate normalized profile/count records
A legacy profile and its opaque cursor remain visible without can-record authority or UUID coercion
